took place on a medieval village island, during spring. A large castle, with scattered wagons and huts, was indicative of this. There were various trees and grass mounds scattered across the map. You could place cliff towers on the grassy mounds. A wheatfield could be seen at the end of the map. A river with two waterfalls side-by-side each other at the end of the river could be seen. At the bottom of this waterfall, some sand and palm trees could be seen. Another waterfall could be seen upstream. Ducks could be seen in the river. Additionally, eggs could be spotted around the map.
The beige cobblestone path began and ended at two caves. The path weaved around cottages and the castle, as well as crossing the river on two stone bridges.
